title: 真题演练 · will 与 be going to
hint: 本组题目按本单元语法点与词池生成/匹配;答错后点击「回溯语法课」复习 will 与 be going to。

questions.q: "I've decided to study abroad next year." I ___ study abroad next year.
questions.analysis: 已经决定好的计划,用 be going to。
说话时临时决定,用 will。

questions.q: Look at the clouds! It ___ rain.
questions.analysis: 有迹象的预测用 be going to。
probably 表示主观推测,与 will 连用。

questions.q: Are you ___ watch the match tonight?
questions.analysis: 疑问句 Are you going to...? 询问已定的安排。

questions.q: 判断对错:He will going to Beijing tomorrow.
questions.analysis: 应改为:He will go to Beijing tomorrow.。will 后接动词原形 go,不能写 going。
